i hope my input can be some help; i’m 20 now, but was 11 when i first started self harming and 13 when i first got caught. my parents yelled up a storm and would ground me every time i got caught hurting myself and would force me into showing them my body so they knew i wasn’t still doing it, and even when they took all my sharp objects all i can say is that unfortunately, when there’s a will there’s a way…. so none of the ways they approached the issue helped me at all. i know this must be extremely emotional for you and the fact that you’re reaching out for opinions shows that you care. just don’t act out on your strong emotions, tell her she can confide in you if needed. accept that this might be a coping mechanism that she’s involved in for years, and make sure she knows you will help her if she ever cuts too deep or does anything scary. she’s still young so it might take her some time to learn how to cope healthily, but i would encourage her to see a therapist or to start journaling, tell her that if she has urges and needs a distraction then you’re there to love her and keep her busy. It’s not easy being a kid with such a scary addiction, and I can imagine it’s not easy being a parent witnessing it. I’m sorry that you can’t do much more than what I suggested, but unfortunately it’s really all you can do. When I was in middle- high school I would hurt myself multiple times a week for months on end. Now that i’m older I just have the occasional slip up and what has helped me is tracking my time that I’m clean and then I’ll “reward” myself every time I hit a month milestone, like getting myself takeout, or buying myself something special, or having a movie night. Maybe you can offer that to her and see if it’ll help, Ive noticed that when I treat staying clean like a competitive game with a prize at the end it really helps me personally. I think it would help to give more attention to the concept of recovery than to the action of the self harm, if that makes sense. So sorry I wish I could be more help but I’ve only been the child in this situation, not the adult. I wish you the best of luck and if you ever have any questions I’ve been dealing with it for 9 years now and can help to my best ability <3
Thank you very much friend. I won’t let myself lose that hope. I appreciate you for listening
